knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Before drilling, ask the occupant about hidden services and choose a point that does not rely on assumptions, so separation is established before work starts. Drilling quickly before residents return, or assuming the wall is empty because no cables were reported, skips that step and is wrong.
Work stops when the exclusion zone cannot be kept or an unassessed hazard appears.
Controls are applied in order: eliminate or substitute first, then separate, then PPE.
